finding.description: Caller-controlled references reach command option positions without enforced rejection.
finding.remediation: Reject option-like references before invocation or use command-specific option terminators and safe object APIs.
finding.title: Command option injection

assessment: Newly reached argv sink using immutable promisify(execFile), literal git and no shell option. Raw taint-slot finding is retained. Source includes -C/-b operands and, for some tools, user ref/remote/branch arguments; generic TypeScriptOptionFlow does not model complete Git option/operand grammar. Source-contexts.json retains exact construction and flow lines. Exploitability is unestablished; potential operand false positives and any real option effects require separate human disposition. No suppression or new advisory claim.
